deep_study_qualification.meaning: The four records outside the 64 pending-deep list are one actual completed study parent plus three unresolved aggregate-intake records. Zero current studied labels reflect later mutually exclusive delivery labels, not zero historical study jobs or four completed investigations.

temporal_qualification.meaning: status() computes lead rows, then creates at inside the output dictionary before computing remaining readiness lists; put writes only after dictionary evaluation. The timestamp is neither an atomic snapshot of every check nor controller exit time. The final stdout object equals the saved progress read after controller exit. Earlier capture-time active/pending-semantic wording remains historical and is not rewritten by the terminal receipt.
temporal_qualification.fingerprint_basis: Frozen ready() validates note/outcome/delivery hashes, assigned markers, current upstream and child fingerprints, and current reconciliation before compare delivery. This review verified the saved controller result and current hash/assignment joins; it did not call status(), ready(), handoff regeneration or independently replay full fingerprints.

residual_qualification: The finite assigned comparison cohort completed. The 44 pending entries are later lead records (42 reconciliation children, 2 comparison children), not 44 failed or admitted comparison jobs. They can be present as evidence for assigned parent reports without independent study/reconciliation/comparison deliveries. Eight unextracted report-intake entries preserve potential further lead extraction; that status does not claim the reports were unread. Research and later intake remain unfinished.

execution_and_write_limits.other_scope_changes: No source/native/receipt/progress/Plans/campaign/D5 edits. Only owned review pair written. All owned command sessions closed after completion.

_review_export.capture_kind: evaluator review with declared transport transformations
_review_export.artifact_identity_policy: artifact: identifiers are nonclickable identities; payload inclusion is not implied. Original reviewer hashes and line locators refer to original artifacts. See reviewer-export-receipt.json.
